name: Moriyasu Saasa
source:
Likes: Reading, acquiring qualifications
Dislikes: Summer, urban life

A teacher who is visiting the ryoutei-ryoukan Sakura En due to a school trip, where she ends up meeting her former student whom she was in love with. Currently, she is a married woman with two children.
